purpose: NTFS special-case fixtures for CP5 Lane C. These filesystem objects are unsafe or impossible to commit into a Git repository on Windows, so integration tests must synthesize them in a scratch directory at runtime. The importer must still contain or reject them per cp5-skill-adversarial-vectors.json.
